evidence.label: Structural theme
evidence.why: Business description matches a long-cycle growth theme (keyword match, so confirm by reading it).

evidence.label: Revenue base
evidence.why: Small base means a big opportunity can move the numbers.

evidence.label: Revenue CAGR, 3 years
evidence.why: Sustained growth of 20%+ compounds fast.

evidence.label: Latest quarter revenue, YoY
evidence.why: Growth is continuing in the most recent results.

evidence.label: Growth acceleration vs 3y trend
evidence.why: Latest quarter growing faster than the 3-year pace. Closest free proxy for a rising order book.

evidence.label: Latest quarter margin vs year ago
evidence.why: Margins expanding as volumes grow.

evidence.label: Operating margin
evidence.why: Healthy margin leaves room to absorb costs.

evidence.label: Margin change over 3 years
evidence.why: Operating leverage: earnings growing faster than sales.

evidence.label: Profit CAGR vs revenue CAGR
evidence.why: Profit outgrowing sales is the signature of a re-rating.

evidence.label: ROCE
evidence.why: Returns on capital show if growth creates value.

evidence.label: Debt / equity
evidence.why: Low debt lets the company fund growth safely.

evidence.label: Operating cash flow / profit, 3 years
evidence.why: Earnings quality: are profits turning into cash?

evidence.label: Interest coverage
evidence.why: Can earnings comfortably service the debt?

evidence.label: Receivable days change, 3 years
evidence.why: Rising receivable days can mean aggressive sales booking or weak customers.

evidence.label: Share count change, 3 years
evidence.why: Little dilution means holders keep their share of the upside.

evidence.label: Free cash flow
evidence.why: Growth that funds itself.

evidence.label: Promoter / insider holding
evidence.why: Owners with skin in the game.

evidence.label: Market cap
evidence.why: Smaller companies have more room to multiply.

evidence.label: Institutional holding
evidence.why: Low institutional ownership leaves room for new buyers.

evidence.label: Analysts covering
evidence.why: Few analysts, less crowded.

evidence.label: Promoter holding change, ~1 year
evidence.why: Promoters adding to their stake is a strong vote of confidence.

evidence.label: Promoter shares pledged
evidence.why: Low pledge means no forced-selling risk.

evidence.label: Promoter/director open-market buying, 6 months
evidence.why: Insiders buying with their own money, from SEBI insider-trading disclosures.

evidence.label: FII holding change, ~1 year
evidence.why: Foreign funds building a position.

evidence.label: DII holding change, ~1 year
evidence.why: Domestic funds building a position.

evidence.label: Capex as % of revenue
evidence.why: Heavy reinvestment signals an expansion phase.

evidence.label: Capital work in progress growth
evidence.why: Plants under construction today become capacity tomorrow.

evidence.label: Gross fixed assets growth
evidence.why: Capacity actually added.

evidence.label: Acquisition in last 2 years
evidence.why: From cash-flow business purchases or a goodwill jump. Check whether it is value-adding.

evidence.label: Order wins, last 120 days
evidence.why: Counted from exchange filings.

evidence.label: Expansion / capacity filings
evidence.why: Announced plants, capacity additions or doubling.

evidence.label: Export-related filings
evidence.why: Export orders or overseas customers. Export margins are not available.

evidence.label: Bonus or split in last year
evidence.why: Improves liquidity and signals management confidence, but creates no value by itself. Worth only a few points in the score.

evidence.label: PE / PEG
evidence.why: Is the price reasonable for the growth?

evidence.label: Price vs 200-day average
evidence.why: Uptrend, but not stretched.

evidence.label: 6-month return vs Nifty
evidence.why: Market is already starting to notice.

evidence.label: Volume, last month vs 6-month avg
evidence.why: Rising volume hints at accumulation.
